purpose: Evidence draft for project/research report; no publication or experiment mutation performed.
exclusions: All summary_CPU_fixture directories and synthetic test_* values excluded from reported experimental results.
CPU-only analyses of real saved experimental data are valid evidence and are labeled as such.

definitions.d_t: abs(log p_theta(a_t|prefix)-log q_behavior(a_t|prefix)); pointwise chosen-token log-probability discrepancy in nats, not perplexity or KL.
definitions.conditional_exceedance_mean: Mean d over tokens whose d>0.5; define0 when no exceedances, and report exceedance count/fraction separately.
definitions.p0_vs_actual_inner_p: Stored round-start p0 differs from actual training p after earlier inner optimizer updates; do not label p0 analysis actual B2 gradient measurement.
definitions.raw_q_vs_behavior_q: Identical for these normal T1, top_p1, top_k−1 decoding paths; decoder penalties/pulses intentionally change behavior q, so use both explicitly.
definitions.PPL: exp(mean token negative log probability), distinct from d; no PPL<0.5 terminology.
definitions.strict_vs_generic_repeat: Strict alphabetic/mechanical legacy rule can miss digit, symbol and token-alias loops; always report normalized_text_cycle128_any and category breakdown.

claims.heading: 持续重复与严重失配的关联很强，但具有模型状态条件
claims.finding: 实际入训 batch701 在 theta700 上，重复标签组75/76达到严重失配阈值，明确正常组0/413；在theta600上，同一正常组230/413也达到阈值。因此不能泛化为“只有重复才失配”或“文本标签独自决定失配”。

evidence.value: All512 actual701 training responses, not allrollout
fraction of response tokens with abs(logp-logq)>0.5 >=0.05

limits: 512条实际入训回答，不是全部rollout；严重定义为一条回答≥5% token 的 d>0.5。
旧标签用于统计分组，shared prompt依赖、长度触顶与重复高度共线；没有长度8192的充分正常对照。
first512与固定位置窗分析缓解部分长度混淆，但不是因果随机干预。
短重复后恢复的row166只有1/1773个token d>0.5，是“有重复必严重失配”的反例。

claims.heading: 权重零落后也能出现大的局部d；循环末端比开端更富集
claims.finding: 两组同权重oracle共选32条回答。native740的极端d既存在于重复内部，也存在于周期变化/结束前；末16 token窗口平均d0.2416，高于内部0.0515和起始16 token0.0780。不能把所有大d定位为首次进入重复的一瞬。

evidence.value: Selected32 responses from two same-checkpoint oracles; selection was8capped+8uncapped per model, not random prevalence.
Exact token periods1..16; >=64tokens and>=16periods; maximal noncontained runs. Last16 before an observed break; censored response end is not a break. Longest containing run wins.

limits: 每个模型选8条触顶+8条非触顶，非随机发生率估计。
这里比较同一权重下不同推理/训练执行路径，排除了版本落后必要性，没有排除数值精度、上下文长度、执行路径等因素。
检测的是精确token周期；异常语义/字符别名可能早于或跨过此边界。
“末端”只指有实际break的末16，触顶截尾不当break。

claims.heading: 大d并非主要来自低概率偶然token
claims.finding: 零落后样本的 d>5 共218个token，全部p<q，q中位数0.9046，179/218的q≥0.5；实际batch771 B2的旧p0-vs-q大差异token更常有接近1的历史q。大量异常续写在给定其异常前缀后是生成器的高概率行为。

evidence.value: Uses saved original_recorded_p0 anchor vs saved rollout_log_probs, not a newly reconstructed inner-update model. Old age not tagged in this export; no inference all tokens cross-weight.

limits: q是给定精确自回归前缀时实际采中token的概率，不是整条异常模式、题目或最终答案的概率。
后半段q高不能推断异常起点也高概率。
771的p是原theta770轮初p0，不是经过B1之后的实际B2训练概率。

claims.heading: 跨权重续写边界不普遍触发d上跳
claims.finding: batch771可精确匹配478/512条、247条含326个版本切换边界。边界前后16-token窗，103次d增加、223次减少，变化中位数-0.01547；64/128窗也多数下降。跨版本影响存在，但“重建/续写边界必然制造突发失配”不成立。
limits: Saved segment metadata checks contiguous token exact equality and q byte equality against full saved collector prefix, itself matched by prompt+UID+response prefix+q bytes; only unique matches admitted.

83 remaining suffixes have inferred version770 using complete saved prefix, unfinished prior state, batch max_version770, saved versions<=769, and single-version transition setup. Their provenance explicitly differs from saved collector_segment; no per-token saved historical segment exists for this suffix.
34 unmatched rows remain outside matched-token/boundary analyses. 32 report min=max770; 2 report769->770 but precise split unavailable. Do not classify all unmatched as no cross-version.

q is probability of sampled token given exact autoregressive prefix under that segment generation weights, not probability of problem/correct answer/full sequence. High q on later repeated tokens does not mean beginning of abnormal mode was probable.
p0 is recorded theta770 round-start probability before step771 actor updates. This is not actual B2 probability after B1; not a direct measurement of actual B2 gradient.
Event-pooled windows can overlap on short neighboring segments; events/tokens are not independent. Association at real version boundary does not identify versionlag vs input/model/execution causes.
claims.correction: 不要把34条未匹配样本都当作没有跨权重；其中2条有769→770但无法定位分割。83条末尾770归属是有证据约束的推断，区别于直接保存的segment。

claims.heading: 注意力双端偏重不等于循环专属的V形因果机制
claims.finding: 同权重native2_740的8条异常回答+8条对照，用HF BF16 teacher forcing回放全部36层×32头。异常起点附近recent128质量在8/8例中上升，均值0.3768→0.4966→0.6170；但“首16和末128每key密度高于中部”的双端指标在正常对照也很普遍。

evidence.value: Bilateral means both first16 and last128 per-key densities exceed the remaining causal-key density. It is not a fitted V or a preregistered hypothesis test. All1152 heads retained.

limits: 这是后验HF回放的attention，不是历史vLLM生成时存下的attention。
指标是双端密度比较，不是拟合的字母V曲线，也不是预注册假设检验。
没有attention干预，因此不能认定它导致重复或d/梯度峰值。
36×32=1152个头全部保留；具体illustrative head为后验选择。

claims.heading: 稳定循环后注意力不主要停留在最初异常过渡区
claims.finding: 固定“异常开始后的128个旧key”平均attention质量由刚过渡时0.6204，降至稳定EES循环0.0463、末段0.0241；后期更大质量分布在累积循环历史、最近128 token与序列起始sink。个别头能持续关注过渡区，不代表总体注意力主要在那里。

evidence.value: No model calls and no remote writes. Fixed historical key windows; each stage uses its single saved center query. Per-head values are interval bounds from 256 bins, subject to FP16 storage rounding, not exact per-head sums. All layers and heads are retained.
Post hoc illustrative heads with lower-bound >50% for the onset±128 window at both EES_run and late; not a preregistered test.

limits: attention_location每阶段使用已保存的中心query；与跨8个query均值的另一个汇总口径有小幅数值区别，不混用。
质量总量与每key密度须区分：大量旧key的总质量可以很高，但每个旧key的密度低。
按头结果由256 bins给上下界并受FP16存储舍入影响；不是精确头内区间和。

claims.heading: 全局 repetition penalty 试验失败，且RP1.05有后端混淆
claims.finding: source720固定权重三arm、各512回答：baseline正确250、持续重复118；RP1.05正确91、重复414；RP1.10正确2、重复511。均未实现持续退化抑制。后验发现RP1.05因网络探测超时切换到native FlashInfer，而baseline/RP1.10使用TRTLLM，故RP1.05不能隔离penalty因果效应。

value.rp105: NVIDIA artifactory timeout caused native FlashInfer fallback

evidence.value: RP1.05 vs baseline is confounded by an attention backend difference and cannot isolate the effect of repetition penalty. RP1.10 and baseline matched this backend dimension. Previous raw numbers remain valid observed measurements, not corrected causal estimates.

limits: 纯固定权重生成+冻结反向诊断，无online optimizer更新。
RP1.10与baseline在后端维度相同，但单面板/单试验不能推断所有强度都失败。
RP1.10的97.0527% token处于own-A=0，own-A梯度小可能只是全错/全对组不产生GRPO信号。
raw q与penalty后的behavior q必须分开；后者含主动解码变换。
冻结730是fixed-history反事实权重，非实际生产730。
claims.correction: 保留旧观测数值，撤回RP1.05纯penalty解释；后续试验显式锁定native FlashInfer/use_trtllm_attention=False并做no-op门禁。

claims.heading: 单目标token的短暂退出pulse没有真正逃离循环
claims.finding: 118个已确认E循环前缀，配对native vs 最多8步将预测循环token概率压至0.5、采到不同token即关闭的一次pulse。116条在8步内换token，但88条只换成文本别名，28条有字符离开后又循环。两arm均118/118继续持续重复并触顶，0自然结束、0新增答对。

evidence.value: 118 previously looping prefixes; conditional restart stress test, not overall64-question G8 model accuracy

limits: 条件是已经陷入循环的118前缀，不代表完整dev64总体正确率；两条最终correct来自前缀中已存在答案。
tokenID变化、decoded文字离开、恢复有意义数学是三种不同事件。
只评估新continuation，不能因固定旧prefix已经有128E直接判失败。
没有语义LLM复核；字符覆盖率不等于每个残余片段已被语义判断。

claims.heading: 冻结梯度下降不等于循环被修复，d也未同步改善
claims.finding: targeted pulse的固定负系数诊断梯度在720从1.5250降到0.3632，反事实730从5433.27降到3756.59；但重复保持118/118，且post8 raw d超0.5条件均值在730从54.3383升到58.6531。这一试验没有成功操纵“减少重复”中介，无法证明减少重复→减少d→改善长期训练的因果链。

value: Only the two NEW native/escape restarts are compared; saved original tails are not exact controls.
All results condition on prior-loop prefixes. Do not call their correctness rate overall model accuracy or a newG8 result.
Token-ID exit can be E->EE, spacedE or whitespace. Decoded-text departure is separate, and neither automatically proves meaningful math recovery.
Post-token-exit recurrence has a post-treatment-selected denominator; fixed posttrigger windows include every case and are the primary recurrence contrast.
First8 behavior q was intentionally transformed. Post8 qraw=qbehavior; active-negative post8 raw gaps align better with the gradient diagnostic.
p720 is the generation model; p730 is a counterfactual fixed-history endpoint. Its gaps include weight changes, not purely engine error.
Common continuation support matches actual token counts/coefficient mass but may exclude late relapse. Original prefix is completely excluded from loss.

If common_support_equals_full_per_arm is true, full/common columns are the same data and coefficients. They are not independent evidence that length confounding was removed; report100%coverage explicitly.
The fixed negative coefficient is counterfactual and can penalize a newly correct continuation; no optimizer update or actual PPO inner-step trajectory is replayed.
The failed run_v1 no-op attempt is excluded. Old globalRP comparison had an attention-backend confound; no causal claim from it is inherited here.

limits: 全部10次backward含复现控制，optimizer steps为0。
full/common在本数据支持完全一致，不是两份独立证据。
完整梯度仍包括最初8步，不能把其下降归因于post8部分。
固定负系数是诊断反事实，不能直接作为正常训练目标。

claims.heading: 720试验没有显示主梯度峰值被解决；后10轮固定E-bank几乎已无有效信号
claims.finding: 721–730的RL-only最大值baseline740.27、UL1153.69；731–740三分支均降到个位数峰值，baseline3.344、ULkeep2.177、withdraw1.937。ULkeep后10轮的有效UL分量最大仅1.94e−24，因此其低峰值不能简单归因于正在持续施加强UL。
